rule: A town or site is known when its first-visit flag or its site flag is set. Flags are copied into a per-town, per-site table at map refresh. One special place (Vault 13 entrance) is also revealed by a time threshold. Factions carry one enemy flag each, set by scripts and read by the ending. Labels and text are from message files that are not in the box. The code read here is the state rule only, which is the part that transfers.
keep: one flag per site, copied into a table on refresh
one time-gated reveal for one special place
one hostility flag per faction, read by the ending
change: our own towns and faction names (not the donor set)
zone-to-faction data table instead of hand-listed flag ids
one known bit per zone on the server ledger; client draws dots only
time gate as a named constant in zone-clock data, not a magic number
ending text chosen on the server from ledger flags
look_test: World map at 375 wide: one region hidden, one zone shown by a visit and one by an event flag set in a test, one zone tinted for an angered faction. Compare fog on and off. Publish to /preview/ with no release rows.
